title: Fix VSCode Extension CI publish step (missing PyPI token)
description: VSCode Extension CI fails on main because the PyPI publish step runs with an empty PYPI_API_TOKEN secret (TWINE_PASSWORD), causing twine upload to 403. Make publishing a no-op when the token isn't configured, and fix setup-node input name.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_acceptance_criteria: - VSCode Extension CI workflow is green on main\n- LSP publish step skips cleanly when PYPI_API_TOKEN is missing
custom.beads_close_reason: VSCode CI publish step now no-ops when PYPI_API_TOKEN is missing, preventing 403 failures.
